text:
Marcos Rivera: heads up — our sampleapp started throwing schema validation errors in staging when using JSON mode + streaming fncalls. seen this after switching to the streaming endpoint yesterday.
Chandra Iyer: ugh, any logs/snippets? is it an SDK parity thing (node vs py)?
Marcos Rivera: logs show partial objects delivered by the stream, validator runs on each chunk and fails. sample log:
```
stream chunk #12: '{"tool_output": {"items": ["a", "b"'
stream chunk #13: ', "c"]}, "call": {"name": "upsert"'
stream chunk #14: '}}'
validator: unexpected end of input at chunk #12'
```
Marcos Rivera: node SDK concatenates and returns whole message for non-streaming, but streaming path emits partial JSON tokens as they arrive — our schema checker is naive and tries to parse each event.
Alice Nguyen: is this because the SDK auto-parses each data event and runs validation on it? we should not validate until a full JSON value is available.
Ben Lee: can we buffer until braces/brackets balance? otherwise we need a proper streaming JSON framing protocol.
Marcos Rivera: yeah, buffering is the simplest stopgap. but need to be careful with large outputs: can't wait until whole thing if it's huge, and we don't want to blow memory or add large latency.
Chandra Iyer: maybe a small helper in SDKs that collects until the top-level JSON is balanced, then emits a single parsed object. name it `collectJsonFrame` or `jsonFrameCollector`.
Alice Nguyen: +1. Also add a fallback: if buffer grows > 128KB or time > 250ms, emit partial as raw string and mark as "partial" so app can decide.
Ben Lee: sounds reasonable. we should keep parity between node and python impls. node: streams are evented; py: async iterator. interface should be the same semantic — yield complete objects or a partial marker.
Marcos Rivera: i'll prototype TS helper today. rough API:
```
for await (const msg of client.stream(...)) {
  const obj = await collectJsonFrame(msg, {maxBytes: 128*1024, maxDelayMs: 250})
  if (obj.partial) { // deliver raw
    // app decides
  } else {
    validateSchema(obj.value)
  }
}
```
Chandra Iyer: add unit tests for nested arrays/strings-with-braces and for fncall edgecases where the tool call contains newline-delimited JSON fragments.
Alice Nguyen: also document behavior in onboarding guide and sampleapp — mention that streaming+jsonmode can produce partial chunks and how the helper resolves it.
devex-bot: created issue #8421 for "streaming-json framing helper + SDK parity" — linking PRs will auto-close when merged :robot_face:
Marcos Rivera: opening draft PR with tests and README updates. will ping when ready for review. anyone want to pair on py impl?
Chandra Iyer: I'll take python followup. will write async iterator version and add integration test against the sampleapp harness.
Ben Lee: note for infra — make sure the ingest -> validator pipeline doesn't double-validate when retries occur (we had one retry that re-ran validation and caused duplicate errors in logs).
Alice Nguyen: good call. also add telemetry labels: streaming_frame_size and frame_delay_ms so we can tune defaults after rollout.
Marcos Rivera: thanks all — will land prototype behind feature flag and add docs in sampleapp. tagging @alice for onboarding notes once PR merges :+1:
Chandra Iyer: sounds good. will add a small example in the sampleapp that shows using the collector with function calls and structured schema validation.
Ben Lee: cool. followup checklist: tests, node+py parity, docs, telemetry, feature flag, PR review. if no objections i'll ship the draft tomorrow.
Alice Nguyen: no objections from me. :shipit:
Marcos Rivera: merging plan: feature-flag roll to dev, run integration tests, then gradual to staging. will update incident channel if anything odd shows up.
devex-bot: deploy pipeline started for branch/streaming-json-collector (staging) — build #7082
